original: Student Journal
string: 学员日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>Moved into my new house, it's great! Can't believe I'm going to study at the college. I'll be the best mage in the entire world. Mom and Dad must be proud of me. They gave me a huge sum of money. I'll be away for a few years so far away. It's kind of scary, being here far away from the warmth of our home.

We had our first lesson today. I got a huge amount of homework, nothing to difficult for me though. Winterhold is awesome so far, can't stop staring at these magnificent buildings, all very ancient. 

There's a huge storm going on in Winterhold at the moment, we're all advised to stay indoors. Didn't know Winterhold was such a cold place, even for Skyrim.

I can't believe it! I just can't believe it! The city fell! It just dropped into the waves. I'm lucky, my house got stuck on a cliff. I never thought a storm could cause this. Hope help arrives soon, but I guess they won't be able to come here until the storm stops. I have a big food supply so I'll be alright, don't worry mom and dad!

Help never arrived and I don't think it ever will, wonder how my parents feel? They probably think I'm dead.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>搬进新家了，太棒了！真不敢相信我要去学院学习了。我会成为全世界最厉害的法师。爸爸妈妈一定为我骄傲。他们给了我一大笔钱。我要离家好几年，去那么远的地方。有点害怕，离家这么远，这里没有家里的温暖。

今天我们上了第一课。作业多得要命，不过对我来说不算太难。冬堡到现在都很棒，我忍不住一直盯着这些宏伟的建筑，全都那么古老。

冬堡这会儿正有一场大风暴，大家都被劝留在室内。真没想到冬堡这么冷，就算对天际来说也是。

我不敢相信！我真的不敢相信！城市塌了！整座城就这么掉进了海里。我算走运，我的房子卡在了悬崖上。我从没想过风暴能造成这种后果。希望救援快点来，但我想风暴停之前他们也没法过来。我存了很多食物，所以我会没事的，别担心，爸爸妈妈！

救援一直没来，我觉得也不会来了。不知道我父母现在怎么想？他们大概以为我死了吧。
</font>

original: Winterhold
string: 冬堡

original: If you're here for sight-seeing, well then you've seen the sights. Might as well head somewhere warmer.
string: 如果你是来参观的，那你已经看完了。还是去个暖和点的地方吧。

original: Don't worry about those Stormcloaks. You're safe from them here. As if they'd want the place anyway.
string: 不用担心那些风暴斗篷。你在这里很安全。说得好像他们真会要这地方似的。

original: Keep clear of the College, and keep yourself out of trouble.
string: 远离学院，别惹麻烦。

original: Hard to believe I ever complained about Riften being cold...
string: 真不敢相信我曾经还抱怨过裂谷城冷……

original: Take care if you're venturing too far from town. That's a bitter wind coming off the Sea of Ghosts.
string: 如果你冒险的时候离开城区太远，要小心了。幽灵海吹来的狂风可不是玩的。

original: Winterhold belongs to Skyrim, not the Imperials, or the mages.
string: 冬堡属于天际，不属于帝国人，也不属于法师。

original: I haven't seen you before. Let me make this clear. I make sure no harm befalls the library.
string: 我没见过你。我把话说明白：我保证图书馆不会受到任何伤害。

original: You so much as lift a finger with ill intent I'll do you in such a way that Oblivion might as well be Aetherius to your rotting carcass.
string: 你要是敢心怀不轨动一根手指，我会让你死得很难看，到时候对你那具腐烂的尸体来说，湮灭都算得上是光界了。

original: Understood?
string: 明白了吗？

original: What are you staring at?
string: 你看什么看？

original: Not exactly a warm welcome.
string: 这可不算是热情的欢迎。

original: If it's a warm welcome you're looking for, you've come to the wrong Hold. Nothing personal sera.
string: 如果你想找热情的欢迎，那你来错领地了。不是针对你，塞拉。

original: Every other day some stubborn Nord comes walking in claiming these books must be burned for they hold demonic secrets.
string: 隔三差五就有固执的诺德人闯进来说这些书必须烧掉，因为里面藏着恶魔的秘密。

original: Can't say they're... entirely wrong about that. Doesn't give them the right to burn them though.
string: 不能说他们……完全说错了。但这也不代表他们有权烧书。

original: So you're a guard?
string: 这么说你是卫兵？

original: I help the Cult with guarding the library as well as other tasks around town.
string: 我帮教团看守图书馆，也在镇上做些别的活。

original: Frode isn't always fair to me, but he pays well.
string: 弗罗德对我有时不太公平，但报酬给得不错。

original: Relatively.
string: 相对不错。

original: You mentioned a library?
string: 你提到过一座图书馆？

original: It's run by the Jhunal Cult. An odd clique, for Nords that is. Not meant as an insult mind you.
string: 它由朱纳尔教团管理。对诺德人来说算是个古怪的小圈子。我可没有冒犯的意思。

original: It's just that their interest in books and all is... quite unusual for their kind.
string: 只是他们对书籍之类的兴趣……在他们这类人里相当少见。

original: They're decent to me and the job pays well so no complaints.
string: 他们对我还算厚道，报酬也不错，所以我没什么好抱怨的。

original: Now, if you're interested in buying you should talk to Skadi.
string: 好了，你要是想买东西，该去找斯卡蒂。

original: What can you tell me about Winterhold?
string: 你能跟我说说冬堡吗？

original: Bit of a dump these days since the Great Collapse. Actually, now that I think of it, was quite a dump back then too albeit a more... intact one.
string: 大坍塌之后，这地方如今有点破败。其实现在想想，当年也挺破的，只不过……更完整一些。

original: There is a lot of bad history between Dunmer and Nords in this city. Most of my kind were purged from Winterhold long ago.
string: 这座城市里，暗精灵和诺德人之间积怨很深。我们族人大半很久以前就被赶出了冬堡。

original: I'm one of the few that remain, but I guess there aren't many Nords left either these days.
string: 我是少数留下的人之一，不过如今诺德人大概也没剩多少了。

original: One thing left that's worth a damn in this city is the College. Sure looks impressive. I've never set foot there though I always wanted to.
string: 这城里唯一还像样的东西就是学院。看着确实气派。我从没进去过，虽然一直想去。

original: Why did you decide to stay?
string: 你为什么决定留下？

original: The only people remaining in Winterhold are those too stubborn to leave.
string: 还留在冬堡的人，都是倔得不肯走的。

original: I was born and raised in this city. I won't allow others to bully me into submission.
string: 我在这座城市出生长大。我不会让任何人把我欺负到低头。

original: Who is Jhunal?
string: 朱纳尔是谁？

original: Jhunal is the Nordic god of knowledge and wisdom, represented by the owl and known to the Imperials as Julianos.
string: 朱纳尔是诺德人的知识与智慧之神，以猫头鹰为象征，帝国人称他为尤里安诺斯。

original: We, who dedicated ourselves to Jhunal, believe the pursuit of knowledge to be the most pure of ways to appreciate creation.
string: 我们献身于朱纳尔的人相信，追求知识是欣赏造物最纯粹的方式。

original: Though these days the owl is shunned by the masses he is still patron to many hermetic orders and clever men found throughout Skyrim.
string: 如今大众虽然避讳猫头鹰，但他仍是一切秘术团体和天际各地智者的守护神。

original: As the reverence of Jhunal has waned, so has Winterhold. A poetic coincidence perhaps.
string: 随着对朱纳尔的崇敬衰退，冬堡也一同衰落了。也许这是种诗意的巧合吧。

original: What is this place?
string: 这是什么地方？

original: This is a library. Sadly this collection is only the shadow of what it used to be as much of it was lost during the Great Collapse.
string: 这里是图书馆。可惜这批藏书只剩昔日的影子，大坍塌时失散了太多。

original: We aim to preserve all that remains and I would gladly give my life to do so.
string: 我们要保全所有残存的东西，为此我甘愿献出生命。

original: I'd like to know more about Winterhold.
string: 我想多了解一些冬堡的事。

original: I'm afraid Winterhold's history has taken a somewhat tragic turn.
string: 恐怕冬堡的历史出现了相当悲惨的转折。

original: You see, you stand here amongst the remnants left to us by the ancient and mighty. This city is one of Skyrim's old seats of power.
string: 你看，你正站在古老而强大的先民留给我们的遗迹之中。这座城市是天际昔日的权力中心之一。

original: It may be hard to believe, but our ancestors did not shun magic like so many do today.
string: 也许很难相信，但我们的祖先并不像今天这么多人那样排斥魔法。

original: No, this city took pride in the arts of the clever men.
string: 不，这座城市曾以智者的技艺为傲。

original: However, though the College of Winterhold may still be Skyrim's most important institute for magic learning, the townsfolk have become...
string: 然而，尽管冬堡学院仍是天际最重要的魔法学府，镇上的人却变得……

original: wary of magic users because of many tragedies.
string: 因为诸多悲剧而提防法师。

original: Many became superstitious after the Oblivion crisis and a large amount of Dark Elves were expelled from the city.
string: 湮灭危机之后，许多人变得迷信，大批暗精灵被逐出这座城市。

original: But perhaps the worst of all these tragedies...
string: 但这些悲剧中最惨的，也许……

original: was the Collapse just about 80 years ago when much of our ancient city was devoured by an unending storm.
string: 是大约八十年前的大坍塌，那场无休止的风暴吞没了我们古城的大部分。

original: The architecture in this city looks ancient.
string: 这座城市的建筑看起来很古老。

original: Indeed. You have a keen eye.
string: 的确。你眼光不错。

original: While much of our beloved city may be gone, these numerous structures surrounding you still tell the tale of a very different age.
string: 我们心爱的城市虽然大半已逝，你周围这些众多的建筑仍在诉说一个截然不同的时代。

original: The old legends tell us the city was founded with but a whisper of a spell by the ancient Arch-Mage Shalidor.
string: 古老传说告诉我们，这座城市是古代大法师沙利多仅凭一声咒语的低语建成的。

original: While not much remains from those times nonetheless these ruins were crafted with the very same techniques
string: 虽然那个时代留存下来的不多，但这些废墟仍是用同样的技艺建造的

original: the clever men of old used to build the grand temples found across Skyrim.
string: 古代智者曾用这技艺建造遍布天际的宏伟神殿。

original: This city was constructed and imbibed with ancient and powerful runes.
string: 这座城市在建造时融入了古老而强大的符文。

original: The townsfolk would do well to remember that.
string: 镇上的人最好记住这一点。

original: What do you do around here?
string: 你在这里是做什么的？

original: Oh my men and I are sailors. We hunt and fish, horkers mostly, as well as do some uh...
string: 哦，我和我的人都是水手。我们打猎捕鱼，主要是海象，也做点，呃……

original: trading from time to time. Anything to gather supplies for our town when the ice allows it.
string: 偶尔做点买卖。只要冰面允许，就为我们镇子收集物资，什么都干。

original: Life out here is harsh but we give it our best.
string: 这里的生活很艰苦，但我们尽力而为。

original: What can you tell me about Winterhold?
string: 你能跟我说说冬堡吗？

original: There's not much to tell. They say Winterhold was once a great city. When I was young I used to play amongst the old ruins.
string: 没什么好说的。他们说冬堡曾是一座伟大的城市。我小时候常在那些古老废墟里玩。

original: Anyhow I don't know about such things. You should talk to Frode about all that.
string: 反正这些事我不懂。你该去找弗罗德谈。

original: All I know is that most folk would rather pack up and leave.
string: 我只知道大多数人宁愿收拾东西走人。

original: I did too once. I wanted to get away as far as possible and so I did. I travelled, I joined the Stormcloaks and fought in quite a few battles before I returned.
string: 我也曾经这么想。我想走得越远越好，也真走了。我四处游历，加入了风暴斗篷，打了不少仗才回来。

original: So you say you're a trader. How about we do some trading?
string: 你说你是商人。我们做点买卖怎么样？

original: I'm not, ehm, not one of those types of traders.
string: 我不是，呃，不是那种商人。

original: I mostly take, without the giving.
string: 我主要是拿，不怎么给。

original: Now, before you say anything, it's a matter of survival. It's all supplies for the town, you see.
string: 先别急着说，这是为了活命。全是为了给镇子弄物资，你明白吧。

original: If you really want to do some trading you should talk to Birna. She doesn't have much, but she has more than I have.
string: 你真想做买卖，就去找比尔娜。她货不多，但比我多。

original: Sailing in these frozen waters must be dangerous.
string: 在这些冰封水域航行一定很危险。

original: Ha. It's not easy that's for sure. The waters here are icebound most of the year, but travelling on the roads is just as dangerous.
string: 哈。那当然不容易。这里的水域一年大半都结着冰，但走陆路也一样危险。

original: The Imperials say all coastal waters between Dawnstar and Windhelm are unnavigable. They wouldn't dare patrol here.
string: 帝国人说晨星到风舵城之间的沿海水域全都无法通航。他们不敢来这里巡逻。

original: Us Nords, however, we make it work. We have to.
string: 可我们诺德人，自有办法。不得不这么干。

original: So why did you return to Winterhold?
string: 那你为什么回到冬堡？

original: I'll try to keep this short. There I was on the battlefield. I do not remember the exact place.
string: 我尽量长话短说。当时我在战场上。记不清具体是哪了。

original: What I do remember is that I pierced a man's chest with my blade. As I pulled him closer I got a look of his eyes, an icy grey.
string: 我记得清楚的是，我的刀刃刺穿了一个人的胸膛。把他拉近时，我看清了他的眼睛，冰冷的灰色。

original: They reminded me of my home. Of the summer snow and the everlasting frozen wastes.
string: 那让我想起了家乡。想起夏日的雪，和永远冰封的荒原。

original: Even more so as they turned cold as he stopped struggling against my weapon.
string: 当他不再挣扎时，那双眼睛变得更冷了。

original: At that moment I thought to myself 'this man had a home too'.
string: 那一刻我心里想：“这个人也有家。”

original: I realized then that I was a fool to leave. That there are people out there who needed me more than the Stormcloaks.
string: 那时我才明白，离开的我是个傻瓜。外面有人比风暴斗篷更需要我。

original: My family, my friends. Now, I fight for Winterhold.
string: 我的家人，我的朋友。现在，我为冬堡而战。

original: I mean no disrespect to the gods, but some of those books in the library. Magic and demons Frode! It's not right!
string: 我无意对神明不敬，但图书馆里那些书。魔法和恶魔啊，弗罗德！这不对！

original: You say you mean no disrespect yet you show disrespect right here and now. How many winters have I spent under Jhunals guidance!
string: 你说无意不敬，可你此刻就在不敬。我在朱纳尔的指引下度过了多少个冬天！

original: And yet you think you know better?
string: 你还觉得自己更懂？

original: But you allow one of those elves...
string: 可你却允许那些精灵中的一个……

original: Stop! I will hear no more of this insolence.
string: 住口！我不想再听这种无礼的话。

original: Elves don't belong at the library.
string: 精灵不该待在图书馆。

original: Really now? Why's that?
string: 是吗？为什么？

original: The cult is an ancient Nordic order. Nordic. You're not a Nord are you?
string: 这个教团是古老的诺德教团。诺德的。你不是诺德人吧？

original: Thank the gods for that.
string: 幸好如此。

original: I don't trust you. What is it you really want from the library?
string: 我不信任你。你究竟想从图书馆得到什么？

original: Well the knowledge and power to summon foul fiends and advance my nefarious plans of course.
string: 当然是召唤邪恶魔物、推进我罪恶计划的知识和力量了。

original: Frode was a fool to take you in.
string: 弗罗德收留你真是个傻瓜。

original: How's Euthymia doing these days?
string: 尤西米娅最近怎么样？

original: She works as a servant for the jarl now. It isn't good work, but we get by.
string: 她现在给领主当仆役。活儿不算好，但日子还过得去。

original: Skadi says she found an old cellar full of books amongst the ruins. Building must've belonged to a mage or a scholar.
string: 斯卡蒂说她在废墟里发现了一个装满书的旧地窖。那建筑八成属于某个法师或学者。

original: Really now? Where? Perhaps I knew the owner.
string: 真的？在哪？也许我认识原来的主人。

original: Hard to say. We will you need your help collecting them.
string: 不好说。总之我们需要你帮忙把它们收集起来。

original: Of course.
string: 当然。

original: Skadi, how are things between you and Magnar? Does he still disapprove of you spending time at the library and the temple?
string: 斯卡蒂，你和马格纳之间怎么样了？他还反对你去图书馆和神殿吗？

original: Hmm? Oh, well. The gap between us seems to be widening. He is just so self-absorbed.
string: 嗯？哦，唉。我们之间的隔阂似乎越来越大了。他太只顾自己了。

original: I see. I am sure he will come around
string: 我明白了。我相信他会想通的。

original: Interesting. So what do you think about all this?
string: 有意思。那你怎么看这些事？

original: I've only heard stories. Not sure if any of them are true.
string: 我只听过些传闻。不确定有多少是真的。

original: Hmm. There must be some truth to it.
string: 嗯。其中总有几分是真的。

original: I lost my family years ago. Truth is, I don't really know what keeps me going.
string: 几年前，我失去了我的家人。说真的，我真不知道自己是怎么坚持下来的。

original: We need strength, power. Not magic.
string: 我们需要的是力量，是实力。不是魔法。

original: Imagine, blowing up an entire town. Damn College... Winterhold will never be the same.
string: 想象一下，把整个城镇都炸了。该死的学院……冬堡再也回不到从前了。

original: Iron or steel is what you need. Leave that fancy Elven stuff to the Elves.
string: 想要好的就买铁或钢的。那些花哨的精灵货，留给精灵去吧。

original: Need your weapon repaired? Or could I interest you in a new one?
string: 需要修理武器吗？或者买些新的？

original: I've got no interest in magic users. No use for their kind at all.
string: 我对法师没兴趣。他们这种人一点用都没有。

original: We must keep faith in ourselves and the Divines.
string: 我们必须对自己和圣灵保有信心。

original: Looks to be another cold day.
string: 看来又是寒冷的一天啊。

original: Bandits sometimes come at night to steal our food. They think that stealing from us is easier than hunting for themselves.
string: 夜间有时会有强盗来偷我们的食物，他们觉得从我们这里偷比自己打猎来得容易。

original: The wise hunter is cautious, always.
string: 聪明的猎人总会保持谨慎。

original: I love the cold air... it's exhilarating. Perhaps it's because of my Nord blood, but there's something about it that makes me feel alive.
string: 寒冷的空气真好……吹得人神清气爽。也许是因为我的诺德血统吧，但这空气里就是有一种东西，让我感受到自己还活着。

original: They can defile our shrine, they can arrest our people and they can silence our voices, but the Empire will never destroy our spirit.
string: 他们可以玷污我们的神龛，可以逮捕我们的人民，可以压制我们的声音，但帝国永远不会摧毁我们的精神。

original: I have to admit. The ancient Nords were ingenious builders
string: 我得承认。古代诺德人真是巧妙的建造者。

original: The Nords of the library are a respectable lot, unlike most.
string: 图书馆那些诺德人值得尊敬，不像大多数人。

original: One thing that keeps me going is spending the evenings with my Euthymia.
string: 让我坚持下去的一件事，就是晚上和我的尤西米娅在一起。

original: Most Nords wouldn't allow me to do anything, but work at the library is... decent.
string: 大多数诺德人什么都不让我做，但在图书馆干活还算……体面。

original: I'm watching you.
string: 我看着你呢。

original: Some of these Nords will come up with any excuse to despise us.
string: 有些诺德人会找任何借口来鄙视我们。

original: Morrowind used to be a lovely place, but you couldn't pay me to live there these days.
string: 晨风曾经是个好地方，可如今给我钱我也不想住那儿。

original: It's been a long time since I walked the ashlands of Vvardenfell. I miss it terribly.
string: 很久没有踏上瓦登费尔的灰烬之地了，真令人怀念。

original: It's so c-c-cold here! If I play outside for too long, I'm going to freeze solid!
string: 这、这里太冷了！在外面玩太久会冻僵的！

original: I want to be a warrior! The strongest one ever!
string: 我想当战士！史上最强的那种！

original: I'm not afraid of anyone. Put a sword in my hand and I could defend this place if I had to!
string: 我谁也不怕。只要我手里有把剑，必要时我就能保护这里！

original: It's been a brutal winter. I can't remember the last time it was this cold, and for this long.
string: 这个冬天真难熬。我都不记得上次这么冷、持续这么久是什么时候了。

original: I have no strong love for the Stormcloaks but I can't say I'm all that fond of the Empire, either.
string: 我不太喜欢风暴斗篷，但我也不是多喜欢帝国。

original: May you be saved by the Divines, as I once was.
string: 愿你像我一样获得圣灵的救赎。

original: Blessings to you. The Divines are listening.
string: 祝福你。圣灵们正在聆听。

original: These days, it seems there is dread everywhere.
string: 如今好像到处都是不祥的气息。

original: I hope you're not one of those magic users.
string: 希望你不是那种法师。

original: I long to be out on the sea again,  but this cold won't allow it.
string: 我渴望再次出海，可这天气不答应。

original: It seems the winters grow longer every year.
string: 冬天似乎一年比一年长。

original: Agh. It's no use hunting in this weather.
string: 这种天气没法打猎。

original: I've got my eye on you, pointy ears.
string: 我盯着你呢，尖耳朵。

original: Are you wise enough to seek counsel from those who serve Jhunal?
string: 你足够明智，来向侍奉朱纳尔的人寻求指引吗？

original: Not many come here these days. What can I do for you?
string: 如今来这儿的人不多。我能为你做什么？

original: Keep your axe sharp. Your wits, sharper.
string: 斧子要磨利。脑子要更利。

original: I wonder how many secrets have been lost here never to be uncovered again.
string: 不知道有多少秘密在此失落，再也无从发掘。

original: You come back if you ever want some fancier armor yourself, now.
string: 如果你想要更漂亮的护甲，随时来找我。

original: If you have spare weapons and armor to sell, bring them here.
string: 如果你有多余的武器盔甲，都可以拿来。

original: Return anytime you need arms or armor. My forge never rests.
string: 需要武器和护甲随时回来。我的锻炉永不歇工。

original: Good hunting.
string: 狩猎愉快。

original: I'm watching you.
string: 我看着你呢。

original: Take great care with the knowledge you possess. It has power to both create and destroy.
string: 谨慎对待你所拥有的知识。它既能创造，也能毁灭。

original: Thinking of settling in? There's a house for sale. You should talk to the steward up in the keep if you're interested.
string: 想在这里安家？有栋房子在出售。有兴趣就去城堡找管家谈。

original: Want to live in this hellhole? There's a house for sale. Frostview Hall. Talk to that rat in the keep, Malur Seloth.
string: 想住在这鬼地方？有栋房子在出售，霜景大厅。去找城堡里那只老鼠马鲁尔·塞洛斯谈。

original: My men and I rebuilt one of the old ruined buildings, Frostview Hall. Interested? Talk to the steward, the elf in the keep.
string: 我和我的人重建了一栋古老的破败建筑——霜景大厅。

original: Thinking of settling in? There's a house for sale. You should talk to the steward up in the keep if you're interested.
string: 想在这里安家？有栋房子在出售。有兴趣就去城堡找管家谈。

original: I would like to purchase a house in the city now that I am thane.
string: 如今我已是男爵，想在这座城里购置一栋房子。

original: Splendid. Another mouth to feed.
string: 太棒了，又多了一张嘴要喂了。

original: Very well, just let me know when you're ready to purchase the house.
string: 很好，你准备买的时候请通知我。

original: I would like to buy Frostview Hall. (4000)
string: 我想买下霜景大厅。（4000）

original: A good house. You chose well. Here is the key to your new home.
string: 好房子。你选得不错。这是你新家的钥匙。

original: Very well, just let me know when you have the necessary funds.
string: 好吧，等你凑够钱再告诉我。

original: Elves don't belong at the library.
string: 精灵不该待在图书馆。

original: I don't trust you.
string: 我不信任你。

original: Frode was a fool to take you in.
string: 弗罗德收留你真是个傻瓜。

original:
Hear us Jhunal, sage God of Runes!

Accept this temple in your guise

here amidst the bleak icy dunes. 

Our old clever men, skilled and wise,

as an owl flew beneath the moons,

on to prove to your watchful eyes, 

toiled once again for your boons.

A six dozen souls dead, awaste.

They yielded many afternoons 

for they worked with such rigid haste.

A great toll paid

fore the last heavy stones were placed.
string:
聆听我们吧，朱纳尔，符文之智神！

请以此形貌接纳这座神殿

就在这荒凉冰丘之间。

我们古老的智者，技艺精湛、智慧深远，

如一只猫头鹰飞掠月下，

为向你警觉的双眼证明，

再次为你的恩赐而辛劳。

七十二条性命枉然消逝。

他们献出了无数个午后，

只因劳作得如此急迫僵硬。

沉重代价已然偿付，

在最后一块巨石安放之前。
